entwurf.thema: Claude Code costs: what the sources show about tokens and budget caps

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Your prompt isn't the first thing sent. Using Claude Code for a coding task? Here's the real cost picture.
teile.szene: Original painted open-world-game poster style: a black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses stands in a dim apartment, arms crossed, wary expression, wide shot, soft lamp light.

teile.name: Overhead
teile.text: A third-party test measured Claude Code sending about 33,000 tokens before a one-line prompt arrived. OpenCode sent about 7,000.
teile.szene: Sourced blog excerpt of the Systima token overhead comparison, showing the Claude Code and OpenCode figures side by side.

teile.name: Subagents
teile.text: Subagents multiply it. One small task cost 121,000 tokens directly, but 513,000 fanned out to two subagents.
teile.szene: Sourced blog excerpt of the Systima subagent finding, comparing the direct run of 121,000 tokens with the two-subagent run of 513,000.

teile.name: Caps
teile.text: So can you cap it? The docs list a spend limit you set yourself, which Claude Code enforces every time.
teile.szene: Official Claude Code best practices page, showing the table row on how much it spends, with the spend limit you've set listed in the column for controls Claude Code enforces.

teile.name: Instruction file
teile.text: Instruction files count too. In that test, a 72KB instruction file added about 20,000 tokens to every request.
teile.szene: Sourced blog excerpt about the 72KB instruction file adding roughly 20,000 tokens to every request.

teile.name: Pricing
teile.text: Free or paid? No prices in these sources, so check Anthropic's page. Your prompt rode second, behind that test's 33,000-token baseline.
teile.szene: Original painted open-world-game poster style: the black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a workshop desk, one hand raised in a stop gesture, thoughtful look, medium shot, warm lamp light.

teile.name: Abschluss
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Original painted open-world-game poster style: the black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses smiles on a city rooftop at dusk, giving a thumbs up, medium shot, warm light.

entwurf.beschreibung: A third-party test found Claude Code sends about 33,000 tokens before a one-line prompt. We show what the docs say about spend limits, and note that these sources list no prices.
